issue.title: Add nightly binary preview CI for internal Android testing
issue.body:
## Summary

Temporary GitHub Actions CI/CD that runs nightly (and on manual dispatch) to produce an **internal Android APK** for testing against the **development API**. Uses EAS via `EXPO_TOKEN` — does **not** require the Expo GitHub App integration.

## Context

The repo is not yet connected to Expo via the org GitHub App. PR preview already works with `EXPO_TOKEN` ([`.github/workflows/preview-build.yml`](.github/workflows/preview-build.yml)). Nightly builds should reuse that auth pattern but ship a **fresh binary only** (no OTA), so they never collide with the PR `preview` Updates channel.

## Scope

- New EAS profile `nightly` (internal APK, dev API URL, no Updates channel)
- Scheduled + `workflow_dispatch` GitHub Actions workflow
- Validation gates, API URL guard, skip-if-no-commits + force, Slack + job summary
- Docs updates
- **Out of scope:** changing PR preview or production release flows; OTA for nightlies; iOS

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Scheduled workflow runs daily and supports `workflow_dispatch` with `force_build` / `notify_slack`
- [ ] Uses EAS profile `nightly`, Android internal APK, baked `https://dev.api.fluent.bible`
- [ ] **Never** runs `eas update` / does not publish to any Updates channel
- [ ] Always starts a **new** EAS binary build when not skipped (no fingerprint reuse of prior APKs)
- [ ] Nightly builds do not inherit the PR `preview` Updates channel; Expo Updates remain disabled for `nightly`
- [ ] Workflow fails if API base URL looks like production
- [ ] Concurrency prevents overlapping nightlies; skip when no new commits unless forced
- [ ] Job summary + Slack success/failure notifications
- [ ] Docs updated; production / PR preview behavior unchanged
- [ ] No Expo GitHub App dependency for this workflow

## Manual setup (outside PR)

- Confirm repo secret `EXPO_TOKEN`
- Add repo secret `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL`
- Enable GitHub Actions failure emails for watchers (email fallback)

## Verification

1. `workflow_dispatch` with `force_build=true` after merge (or on the PR branch if secrets allow)
2. Confirm install URL is a new APK; app does not pull PR preview OTAs
3. Confirm Slack + Actions summary
4. Confirm PR `preview-build` label path still works
